{{Top|leg}}
'''Krayt eggs''' were a delicacy, and often found at state dinners. Despite their starvation, the [[Taat]] nest of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] would have acquired these for the members of the [[Myrkr strike team]], and would have been insulted if they weren't eaten.
